Thank you for choosing SSC English PRO. This Refund and Cancellation Policy outlines the guidelines regarding purchases of the SSC Pro Pass or any in-app digital services.

1. Google Play In-App Purchase Refunds

All in-app purchases and subscription upgrades (such as Pro Pass ₹29) are processed exclusively through Google Play Billing. As such, Google Play's standard refund policies apply:

  • Within 48 Hours: If less than 48 hours have passed since you made the purchase, you can request a refund directly through the Google Play Order History page.
  • After 48 Hours: For technical failure, accidental duplicate billing, or unactivated passes, please contact our support team directly.

2. Duplicate Billing & Technical Issues

If you were charged multiple times for the same transaction due to a network glitch or if your Pro Pass failed to activate after a successful payment:

  • Please send your Google Play Order Receipt (Order ID starting with GPA.XXXX-XXXX) to edupluscreation@gmail.com or WhatsApp at +91 7296821670.
  • Our support team will verify the transaction and either manually activate your Pro Pass or initiate a full refund within 24 to 48 business hours.

3. Cancellation Policy

The Pro Pass is a one-time lifetime / duration access digital educational pass. There are no recurring auto-debit charges or hidden subscription fees unless explicitly opted into a recurring monthly tier.
